name: Lovable
design_analysis_text: 現行首頁以 Camera Plain Variable 字體、彩色 Lovable 商標、中央對話框與脈動漸層展開。三張產品示範卡後是深色平台區，依序呈現 Hosting、app stack、payments、security、跨裝置五組官方 SVG；再接六品牌、客戶輪播、1.2/60/900 million 數據與圖表、結尾對話框和完整多欄頁尾。此次逐段觀測顯示主要內容與原生 Stitch 參考相同，因此保留既有真正 DESKTOP 與已補正 actual MOBILE 輸出。本次改正原草稿客戶區、頁尾及完整平台區版面，仍誠實保留漸層動畫差異。
visual_review_text: Owner inspected all eight final paired montage rasters and official/local mobile root menu states. 13 desktop and14 narrow viewport screenshots per side cover the entire page. Native1280×720/390×844 originals retained. Main layout/copy, three feature frozen frames, five platform artworks, trusted logos, captured desktop Klar and narrow eXp Realty customer state, metrics, chart and footer were compared. Main page heights are9333/11218px in both reference and local. Hero static texture is visibly paler and differs in gradient placement from the live canvas; it is explicitly unresolved. Cropped desktop compositor diagnostics were excluded and replaced by fresh-tab native captures.

native_generation.retention_reason: Fresh current official full-page observation shows unchanged main content/layout relative to existing genuine native reference. Original requests/responses/exports remain unchanged.

implementation_method: Current rendered public DOM/CSS and101 preserved original assets corrected the previously generated Stitch study. Static visible feature/customer states retained; frozen original pulse texture replaces the dynamic canvas with explicit visual limitations.
corrections: Rebuilt full platform layout using current original artwork and observed per-width DOM, restoring geometry/content through the footer.
Restored current desktop Klar / narrow eXp Realty visible customer layouts, six trusted brands, chart and complete footer; removed simplified draft-only customer layout and copyright.
Corrected animated heading masks so complete visible text persists in the frozen study.
Copied observed official mobile root menu markup, toggle X state, Escape closing and body scroll lock.
remaining_differences_and_limits: The hero pulse canvas is represented by a preserved original static texture. Its color intensity and vertical gradient placement remain visibly different from the live official canvas at both widths; exact canvas/word/prompt animations are not matched.
Three feature demos and the captured customer carousel state are frozen; source customer navigation, other customer states, autoplay and transitions are not fully implemented/verified.

Root mobile menu open and Escape close were tested. Its fixed opaque background differs from the captured official transition frame; nested Solutions/Resources, desktop navigation and language selector remain unverified.
Composer typing, Build, voice, login/signup, billing, live service behavior, external destinations, other widths, physical phones and hosted publication are outside this scoped review.
Original native MOBILE correction retains reference headings but changes ordering/media URLs; provider outputs remain unaccepted and separate from the source-corrected reviewed preview.
progress_note: Current-hash full desktop/narrow main-page raster coverage and actual inspection completed; 9333/11218px heights agree, originals/layout/footer corrected. Hero gradient/canvas, transitions and UI/service differences explicitly unresolved; accepted=false.
